feature_selection: Compare identical baseline XGBoost settings on two grouped training CV folds; choose lowest mean unweighted log-loss. Original control retained; no forced engineered-feature promotion.
features: Numeric originals retained. Six true ordered scales as numeric, other categories one-hot with binary reference dropped. Engineered: seven-factor social risk count, unhealthy days >=14 and log1p, three sleep bands, BMI 1st/99th percentile clipped copy. All fit-dependent values learn within fold.
risk_rule: job_loss/bill_difficulty/utility_threat/transport_barrier ==1; food_insecurity/isolation <=3; support>=4. Count is an engineered predictor, not a validated clinical score.
search: Optuna TPESampler seeded; sequential, no pruning, two grouped training folds; inner 10% early-stop split per fold; full training search partition, not a small sample.
calibration: Reserve grouped 10% of original training before all feature selection/tuning. Final model fit excludes calibration data. Split calibration reserve into fit/check halves; fit positive scalar temperature on first half, enable only if independent calibration-check logloss improves and Brier does not worsen. Fixed accepted temperature; no refit on check.
final_fit: 90% of search partition fit, 10% internal early-stop. Calibration reserve never used in fitting or hyperparameter search.
operating_point: On existing validation choose highest accuracy with high recall >=max(.60,current original XGB validation recall); no decreases in macro-F1, QWK or middle recall vs original matched-cutoff baseline and deployed baseline. Threshold chosen separately from calibration and tuning. Ensemble existing weights with candidate XGB and one separately selected cutoff, same safeguards vs current ensemble.
promotion: Atomic XGB+ensemble update only if both validation eligible, both final test meet non-degradation safeguards vs current and matched originals, each high recall >=max(.60,current respective test recall), paired accuracy delta CI lower>0, plus runtime512MiB/API checks. Otherwise retain current versions. No alternative chosen using test.
evaluation: Existing internal test is historically reused, NOT independent validation. Freeze configuration, model/encoder/calibration hashes and cutoffs before one final evaluation. No test tuning.
baseline: Always rarely: historical holdout65.78% accuracy and 0% high recall; report actual partition baseline too.
